recent.text: Erik Gustafsson back on the ice with the @LAKings today! Encouraging, after missing the last two games.
recent.author: Zach Dooley

recent.text: On November 13, 2010, Dustin Brown scored his first career penalty shot goal in a 5-1 win over the New York Islanders. Anze Kopitar recorded his 300th career point, and the @LAKings set a team record for longest home winning streak to start a season (8-0-0). #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/fsKDGJRKNX
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 13, 2005, @LAKings forward Alexander Frolov recorded his first career NHL hat trick. Craig Conroy also scored three goals, and Pavol Demitra had four points in an 8-2 win versus the Columbus Blue Jackets. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/7Im0Joutdo
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 13, 2000, Bob Miller, the legendary voice of the @LAKings, was inducted into the Hockey Hall of Fame. The NHL Broadcasters' Association presented Miller with the Foster Hewitt Memorial Award for his outstanding contributions to the game of hockey. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/70jvSgWhMS
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 13, 1995, rookie @LAKings defenseman Aki Berg recorded his first career NHL point. Berg assisted on goals from Tony Granato and Wayne Gretzky in a 4-2 win over the Mighty Ducks of Anaheim. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/XJqU3vSKG8
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 13, 1995, the @LAKings acquired defenseman Steven Finn from the Tampa Bay Lightning for Michel Petit. In two seasons with the #LAKings, Finn recorded five goals, 10 points, and 186 penalty minutes in 104 games. #GoKingsGo https://t.co/2xEc7ntVbz
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: Happy 32nd birthday to Sean Walker. The former @LAKings defenseman was born on November 13, 1994. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/U5kg56tKj5
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 13, 1984, @LAKings center Bernie Nicholls scored four goals against the Quebec Nordiques. Nicholls scored a goal in each period, including the game-winning goal in overtime in a 5-4 win for the #LAKings. #GoKingsGo https://t.co/BmokvQituZ
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: Happy 58th birthday to Mark Fitzpatrick. The former @LAKings goaltender was born on November 13, 1968. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/vDCBvYkMj6
recent.author: The Kingstorian
